notes: Protected pages are polished third-party, paper-companion, or course-project pages identified by explicit author attribution, named-paper framing, or course-project listing. Borderline pages default to protected. bodySha256 is the SHA-256 of the markdown body only, everything after the closing frontmatter delimiter, exactly as extracted by scripts/validate-models.js parseFrontmatter. introExempt is true for every entry: protected page bodies are never edited to add an introduction. Editors may still recategorize a protected page via its frontmatter (for example model-category) without tripping the hash check, since the hash only covers the body. Regenerate an entry hash only after an explicitly authorized, reviewed change to that page body.
